pattern_explanation: These feeling words are matched by meaning, and each Ukrainian word has its own history in its language. The look-alike between one Ukrainian word and an English word is a coincidence rather than a shared origin.
false_friend_warning: The Ukrainian word for embarrassment, transliterated 'konfuz', looks similar to the English verb 'confuse', which means to make someone unclear or bewildered. Learners may wrongly match the Ukrainian word with 'confuse' because of the similar spelling.
